entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oooh, it's open!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is the second one... I wonder how[n]many more there are...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm sure we'll find out as we go. Let's keep[n]moving to our next one!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Check it out! This one's open for us now[n]too!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This movement... There can be no doubt.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm? Did you notice something?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This entire floor... is the cylinder of a lock.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wh-What do you mean...? Can you[n]explain that a little more...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The cylinder is the mechanism that judges[n]if a key is the proper shape.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If you use the correct key and all the discs[n]align, the lock opens.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now that you mention it, while the walls[n]rotate, the path forward has remained[n]facing the same way...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you're saying the whole floor is just[n]one giant lock...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's right. All the smaller vaults in here[n]aren't important.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There has to be an area further in, locked[n]away by the room itself.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And that's where the Treasure's gotta be![n]Sweet, let's get goin'!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-Hey, this is an elevator, yeah? So a way[n]down really did show up...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're like some kinda prophet, Queen...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's mostly thanks to that notebook. We[n]wouldn't be here if it weren't for that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: More importantly, did you hear all those[n]things Shadow Kaneshiro was saying?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, I was wondering about that![n]Didn't he seem kinda... insecure or[n]something?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Exactly. He kept bringing up how rich and[n]powerful he wants to be.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So if he's insecure about that shit...[n]he thinks he's really just some poor[n]weakling, huh?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Maybe by thinking he was going to be[n]a strong, wealthy man, he convinced[n]himself it was true.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wonder...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, we will discover the truth for[n]ourselves when we change his heart.[n]Let us hurry, Joker.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tch, another one of these jerks!? What's it[n]doin' here!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Look, behind it!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Another button device... The Shadow[n]must be protecting it...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It seems like we'll have to take it down to[n]move on... Are you ready for this, Joker?
Hell yeah, I am.
Hold on.

entries.speaker: Security Shadow
entries.en: Hmph, you guys must be the rats we've[n]been hearing about...

entries.speaker: Security Shadow
entries.en: Well, Mr. Kaneshiro ordered me to[n]absolutely not let anyone past this point.

entries.speaker: Security Shadow
entries.en: Accept your death!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, make sure you're prepared.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You ready, Joker?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we want to keep going, we'll need to[n]send out a calling card.
entries.uk: Щоб іти далі, треба надіслати[n]візитну картку.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh, there's names on each of these little[n]vault things.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I bet these are all the people who've[n]ended up as Kaneshiro's "customers."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, I'm never gonna forgive that bastard[n]for all this...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Still... I never expected such a place to[n]exist underneath that flying bank...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I guess anything is possible in a cognitive[n]world.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There are so many smaller vaults in here.[n]That must mean...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is how many people have fallen[n]victim to Kaneshiro's crimes in the[n]real world.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So they're representative of just how[n]rotten Kaneshiro really is... He won't[n]get away with this.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, a humongous basement vault filled[n]with money and lined with a multitude of[n]smaller vaults...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems he is no different from[n]Madarame. Something terrible[n]is held deep within his psyche...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna squash that bastard like the[n]stupid bug he is!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I agree.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've been searching, but I can't seem to[n]find a vault in here with my name on it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If you do find one, feel free to destroy it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, I think I'll do just that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The number of vaults here is[n]overwhelming...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd say looking at this is probably a point of[n]great pride for Kaneshiro.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... all of that'll be over soon.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Seein' all this cash and shit might dull my[n]senses for money...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is clearly what happened to[n]Kaneshiro. It is plainly evident[n]from looking at this place.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But that's because of how incredibly[n]greedy he is. I look forward to his[n]Treasure...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just how many of these vault things're in[n]here...? I don't wanna even try to count[n]'em...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All the places we've been to up till[n]now were pretty crazy... but this is[n]really something else...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Each one of these represents a victim he[n]tormented... This is frightening...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I may not be the wealthiest of people... but[n]I hope to never become like this man.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is the fitting heart for a cognitive[n]world so deeply focused on money...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You could prolly buy a whole country[n]with this much cash... I'm kinda jealous...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, I shouldn't be thinkin' about that[n]kinda stuff...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I was thinking this back with Madarame[n]too... but there really is no limit to people's[n]greed.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This scale is insane... Kaneshiro's heart[n]might be even more distorted than[n]Kamoshida's or Madarame's...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We'd best hurry and erase this foul[n]Palace...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm willing to bet there are some Shujin[n]students among all these too...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's prolly no use askin' this in the[n]Palace...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But what the hell's Kaneshiro tryin' to do[n]with all this money?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why does he need to go so far as[n]scamming... tormenting people...[n]just for money...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is undoubtedly the Palace of[n]a money hoarder... though I don't[n]know how it turned out like this.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: People naturally gravitate toward wealth,[n]but this... this is preposterous...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If this Palace disappears... all of these[n]people will be saved, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I bet phantom thieves'd steal cash all the[n]time... but nobody would want this dirty[n]money.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A gentleman thief from the olden days[n]would have stolen this money and shared[n]it across the city...
